name: PTC Industries Ltd.
about: PTC Industries Limited manufactures and sells high-precision metal castings in India and internationally. The company offers torque tubes, airframe structural components, engine mounts, turbine frames, engine liners, swirlers, and injectors for aircraft structures and propulsion systems; turbine frames, blades, buckets, vanes, inlet and outlet structures, and bearing housings for aero engines; and airframe structures, casings, bearing housings, refueling nozzles, turbine oil tanks, and engine gear boxes for air defense, as well as other casings for land defense. It also provides pump components, valves, on-line fittings, radar structures, and propellers and propulsion components for naval platforms, as well as propellant tanks, propulsion nozzles, bulkheads, pressure bottles, and lightweight structural elements for precision-guided and long-range defense systems.
